title: Wire daily check-ins into Dataset Candidate creation
purpose: Compose only the daily check-in source transaction with the Dataset creation seam so check-in evidence becomes a raw non-trainable candidate without merging the separately owned measurement flow.
success_outcome: Every newly completed daily check-in atomically creates one daily_check_in Dataset Candidate with exactly one observation ref and default false trainability; failure rolls back the check-in/candidate together, same-row seam retry is idempotent, new check-ins remain distinct, and existing observation/freshness/Timeline/public outcomes are unchanged.
anti_goals: Manual measurement candidate wiring, check-in API/observation semantic changes, evidence association, lifecycle, agent runtime, or backfill.
evidence_required: FT-014-AC-009 RED: after TASK-047 and before this wiring, create_check_in commits no candidate for check_in_id; GREEN: one exact raw/default candidate and event ref commit in the same UoW; decisive comparison: source identity, rollback in both failure directions, same-row retry, distinct new check-in, and unchanged CheckInResult/freshness; artifact: focused PostgreSQL transcript under .tasks/TASK-051-T3-FT-014-W2/.
constraints: Plant Operations retains command/UoW and passes only the persisted DailyCheckIn identity; combined check-in-with-measurement remains two source rows and TASK-052 owns the measurement candidate.
Do not change observation validation, freshness ordering, or public response shape.
invariants: Check-in candidate creation cannot promote Plant state or Dataset trainability.
Unauthorized/archived Plant operation creates no source row or candidate.
verification_targets: FT-014-AC-009: check-in-only and check-in-with-measurement controls, source/candidate/audit rollback, same-source idempotency versus new-row identity, current authorization/archive behavior, and unchanged service/API result.
